headline: Macro favors Capital (Labor Share 93.7, Profits/Wages +7.5%); Equities show 3M pullback in AI hardware (-14.12%) vs. IT/Staffing bounce (-6.32%)

bullets.title: Labor Share Compression
bullets.text: BLS Nonfarm Labor Share stands at 93.73 (-0.67% QoQ, -1.60% YoY), remaining structurally below the 2017=100 baseline.
bullets.reason: Real output growth is accruing to capital owners faster than compensation: nonfarm payrolls sit at 159.3M with average weekly hours capped at 34.4h and hourly earnings at $38.00/hr.

bullets.title: Profits Outpacing Wages
bullets.text: Corporate Profits-to-Wage-Bill ratio hit 0.404 (+7.50% QoQ, +22.00% YoY).
bullets.reason: BEA Corporate Profits expanded to $4,279.9B SAAR (+8.40% QoQ, +26.61% YoY) while the annualized private wage bill grew only +0.47% MoM (+4.30% YoY) to $10,827.8B.

bullets.title: Watchlist Spread Drivers
bullets.text: 3M Watchlist Spread is -7.80pp (Capital Enablers -14.12% vs. Labor-Heavy -6.32%).
bullets.reason: Short-term multiple compression hit AI hardware/power names (SMCI (-32.4%), NVDA (-28.6%), VRT (-25.9%)), while oversold IT outsourcers & staffing rebounded (EPAM (+45.1%), INFY (+0.8%), CTSH (-2.7%)). Over 1Y, hardware/grid winners (ANET (+53.0%), GEV (+43.1%), PWR (+39.6%)) still anchor the capex cycle.

bullets.title: AI & Power Capex Catalyst
bullets.text: "DC Blox files for third building at Atlanta West data center campus" (Data Center Dynamics).
bullets.reason: Compute & silicon capex expansion shifting income toward capital owners. Also tracked: "Texas environmental regulator resumes data center permitting following ERCOT review" (Data Center Dynamics).

bullets.title: Workforce & Macro Signal
bullets.text: "Outdoor Recreation Economic Statistics, U.S. and States, 2025" (BEA Macro Releases) — with U.S. unemployment at 4.1% (2026-10-01).
bullets.reason: Macro / cost-of-capital policy shift affecting capex vs. hiring.
